definitions.explanation: A feeling of wanting to cause harm or trouble for someone; hostile intent.
In legal contexts, knowledge that one's action is wrongful or that a claim is unfounded.

examples.japanese: {悪意|あくい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
{悪意|あくい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{書|か}き{込|こ}み→書き込み：09225_kakikomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{削除|さくじょ}→削除：04171_sakujo⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悪意|あくい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{込|こ}められている→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。

examples.english: Property acquired in bad faith is not protected.

notes:
The antonym is ⟦{善意|ぜんい}→善意：11813_zeni⟧ (good will; good faith). In everyday use, sense 1 is far more common. Sense 2 is a specific legal term where {悪意|あくい} means "with knowledge" (that something is wrong), contrasting with ⟦{善意|ぜんい}→善意：11813_zeni⟧ (without knowledge).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪意|あくい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have ill will
- {悪意|あくい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: malicious (as modifier)
- {悪意|あくい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧: full of malice
- {悪意|あくい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to harbor ill will

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{敵意|てきい}→敵意：16853_tekii⟧: hostility — stronger, implies open antagonism
- {害意|がいい}: intent to harm — more specific about causing damage
- ⟦{悪気|わるぎ}→悪気：28204_warugi⟧: malicious intent — more colloquial, often used in ⟦{悪気|わるぎ}→悪気：28204_warugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (meant no harm)
